topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the key themes of cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions, and states the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how Darwinian selection acting on somatic driver mutations and epigenetic alterations drives clonal expansion and the acquisition of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cells
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the tissue hierarchy models of cancer development and review experimental evidence for cancer stem cells across leukemia and colorectal systems.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how external environmental exposures and local inflammatory signals act as promoters to induce stem-like states and drive malignant transformation in mutated tissues.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the dependence of established tumors on supportive stroma, the spatial and single-cell technologies used to map these cellular interactions, and a comprehensive summary of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the concluding remarks and previews the topic of the next lecture.
